subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeMath
subsystem.responsibility: Freestanding SIMD math helper collection: SSE routines for 3x3 submatrix determinants, plane-from-three-points construction and normalization, 3-vector normalization, 4-component velocity friction clamping with a stiction threshold, and quaternion composition from axis-angle components; plus 3DNow!/MMX packed kernels for quaternion products and barycentric/bilinear/cubic/quartic/quadrilinear interpolation. All functions are pure computation helpers with UNKNOWN owners; most make no calls and touch no globals beyond read-only constant tables. The grouping into one math library is a DERIVED synthesis from the packet summaries, not an attested source organization.

summary: The packet covers 21 freestanding SIMD math helpers with UNKNOWN owners. The SSE family computes 3x3 determinants from a 4x4 matrix, constructs/normalizes plane equations from three points, normalizes 3-vectors with Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt refinement, clamps 4-component velocity below a stiction threshold, and composes a quaternion from axis-angle components (calling sub_528CC0). The 3DNow/MMX family computes quaternion products and packed barycentric, bilinear, cubic-Hermite, quartic and quadrilinear interpolations, many with explicit region classification and per-region normalization. Every function writes to a per-call 16-byte output buffer addressed as base 'this' (+0x0..+0xC) and several rely on read-only constant globals for refinement scales and sign-flip masks. Two synthetic classes are proposed (SSE and 3DNow families); ownership and exact global-to-constant bindings remain UNKNOWN.

function_roles.role: Compute the determinant of the upper-left 3x3 submatrix of a 4x4 row-major matrix via SSE cofactor expansion, with an alignment guard between aligned and unaligned row loads.
Construct a plane equation (N, D) from three points via SSE edge vectors, cross-product normal, Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt normalization, and sign-flipped distance term.
Normalize a 3-component vector using Newton-Raphson reciprocal-length refinement and apply a Z sign-flip mask.
Clamp a 4-component velocity vector: below a squared-length stiction threshold write zeroes, otherwise scale all four components via Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt refinement.
Construct a normalized plane equation from three points with SSE cross product, Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt refinement, and sign-flipped distance component.
Compose a quaternion from three axis-angle float components, invoking sub_528CC0 as the composition helper and completing with packed sign-mask arithmetic.
Multiply two quaternions supplied as 3DNow packed half-pairs, forming cross/dot terms with sign-bit XOR and pfacc, then exiting MMX state.
3DNow barycentric interpolation that classifies the query into one of four triangle regions via a packed comparison mask and normalizes the selected edge with Newton-Raphson refinement.
3DNow quad/edge intersection helper using a packed-mask branch to pick one of four regions, each normalizing its edge and writing interpolated and blended attribute vectors.
Multiply two quaternions as 3DNow operand pairs, using PackedFloatingPointMath (sub_5295E0) three times for component setup and a sign-flip XOR constant.
Affine weighted blend over an 8-pair coefficient table driven by three weight scalars, producing two packed output pairs including the a3[6]/a3[7] addend terms.
Non-affine weighted sum over a 6-pair coefficient table driven by three weight scalars; omits the addend terms and stores only the low 32 bits of the second slot.
3DNow bilinear interpolation between a base point and two delta points with two scalar weights, writing a full packed pair and a low-dword scalar.
Cubic Hermite spline interpolation over packed control points, building the four standard Hermite basis functions from packed 1.0f/2.0f/3.0f constants.
3DNow interpolation between four packed control points parameterized by a scalar factor, blending first elements and low lanes of second elements and scaling by 0.5.
Cubic Hermite spline interpolation of packed float pairs using 3DNow SIMD, writing only the full 64-bit packed result to the output.
Packed two-lane bilinear interpolation helper computing a1 = a2 + (a3-a2)*a5 + (a4-a2)*a6 with duplicated weights.
3DNow higher-order blend-weight interpolation (quartic basis) over four packed control points scaled by 0.5; caller and true interpolation basis unknown.
Compute a quaternion product from two packed quaternion operands (plus an intermediate input), building cross-product terms and assembling two output halves with sign-flip XOR.
Two-weight barycentric interpolation on two packed float pairs, computing both output component pairs as weighted sums of three inputs.
Straight-line 3DNow cubic Hermite interpolation kernel writing two blended pairs from four control points and a scalar parameter.

classes.name: SSEMathHelpers
classes.responsibility: Synthetic grouping of the SSE (non-3DNow) math helpers in this packet: 3x3 determinant from a 4x4 matrix, plane-from-three-points and plane-from-edges construction with Newton-Raphson normalization, 3-vector normalization, velocity friction clamping with stiction threshold, and quaternion composition from axis-angle components. All members write to a per-call 16-byte output buffer at base 'this' and several read normalization/refinement constant globals. The class boundary is inferred from the shared SSE intrinsic flavor and output-buffer convention; no owner evidence exists in the packet.

classes.name: Packed3DNowMath
classes.responsibility: Synthetic grouping of the 3DNow/MMX packed math kernels in this packet: quaternion products (three variants), barycentric interpolation with region classification, quad/edge intersection, weighted point blends/sums, and bilinear, cubic-Hermite, quartic and quadrilinear interpolation over packed __m64 control points. Members share the packed-float idiom, the read-only 3DNow constant-table globals (0x005AF8F0..0x005AF9A0), the two __m64 output-half convention at this+0x0/this+0x8, and _m_femms state hygiene. The class boundary is inferred from the shared 3DNow intrinsic flavor; no owner evidence exists in the packet.

state_machines.name: MMX3DNowExecutionState
transitions: _m_femms on entry clears pending 3DNow/MMX state before packed-float arithmetic.
_m_femms before return leaves the 3DNow/MMX state clean so the x87 FPU remains usable by the caller.

compatibility_contracts.name: 3DNowStateHygiene
compatibility_contracts.description: The 3DNow/MMX kernels emit _m_femms on entry and before returning. A replacement must preserve this state discipline so x87 floating-point code running after these helpers is not corrupted.

compatibility_contracts.name: OutputBuffer16ByteLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: All helpers write results into a per-call 16-byte output buffer addressed as base 'this': SSE helpers fill a four-float quad at +0x0..+0xC, 3DNow helpers write two __m64 halves at +0x0 and +0x8 (some only the low half or a low-dword scalar). A replacement must keep the same output addressing so callers observe results at the expected offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: NewtonRaphsonReciprocalRefinement
compatibility_contracts.description: The plane/vector-normalization and stiction-clamp helpers refine the reciprocal length with Newton-Raphson steps driven by read-only constant globals (refinement coefficient 0.5 and scale constants). A replacement must honor these constant roles to reproduce equivalent normalization and threshold behavior.

unresolved: All 21 functions have UNKNOWN owners; the classes SSEMathHelpers and Packed3DNowMath are synthetic groupings inferred from the shared SIMD flavor and output-buffer convention, not attested objects.

Base 'this' in the packet denotes a per-call output pointer, not a shared object. Equal byte offsets across functions (e.g. this+0x0 in every helper) are not proof of a common struct; the two classes must not be read as owning a single layout.
field:this:0x00000004 is read by 0x0051F89E and 0x0052098E without an explicit explanation in the raw SSE text; likely a decompiler artifact of the returned pointer rather than a real semantic read.

The exact binding between the 3DNow constant globals (0x005AF8F0, 0x005AF900, 0x005AF910, 0x005AF918, 0x005AF920, 0x005AF968, 0x005AF980, 0x005AF988, 0x005AF990, 0x005AF998, 0x005AF9A0) and the inline __m64 literals (1.0f, 2.0f, 3.0f, 0.5f, sign-flip masks) is not recoverable from this packet; Hex-Rays folds the read globals into immediates.

Exact values of the SSE normalization/refinement globals 0x005D8AD0, 0x005D8AE0, 0x005D8AF0, 0x005D8C30, 0x005D8C40, 0x005D8C50 and the velocity-clamp constants 0x008D618C, 0x008D6190, 0x008D6194 are not evidenced; only their roles (sign flip, 0.5 refinement, scale, threshold) are DERIVED.

For 0x00520E0E the composition globals 0x008D62A0/0x008D62B0/0x008D62C0 are read but their values and exact roles (sign mask, scale, axis-angle packing constant) are unverified; the role of sub_528CC0 is unknown beyond address.

No static callers are evidenced for any helper, so the consumption contexts (terrain heightfield, camera path, vehicle physics, collision geometry) are unknown; the plane-from-points and velocity/stiction interpretations rest on legacy ABI names.
The packed-lane to w/x/y/z mapping for the quaternion products (0x00520ED0, 0x005214AA, 0x0052704A) is not recoverable from any single function.
qword_5AF918 is listed as a read global by 0x00520ED0 but is absent from the raw decompiled text; its role (an MMX packed constant) is unproven.
Callees 0x00528CC0 and 0x005295E0 are referenced by this packet but are outside its function set, so their semantics and the exact composition/product math they contribute are unresolved.
Plane helpers mix double inputs (const double* points) with float output quads; the low 64-bit lanes of loaded points are left uninitialized by _mm_loadh_ps and do not contribute to the stored plane.

The barycentric region-classification masks (v13 & 1, 0xFF00FF00, 0x10000 in 0x00521079; 0xCC, 0x10 in 0x00521295) are inferred as triangle-region splits from the structural twin relationship; not proven identical.
Input tables a2/a3 (vertex-component blocks and coefficient tables) of the 3DNow interpolation kernels have no identity in the fact table; only the output base 'this' is recorded.
